priorAttemptBatches.prompt: Photorealistic architectural concept image for a small working harbor convenience store named HARBOR MARKET, before implementation in a 3D game. One wide landscape street-level photograph in natural late-afternoon coastal daylight. A compact single-story 14 by 10 meter store, flat roof, navy painted metal fascia, understated white HARBOR MARKET letters, a central wide open sliding-glass entrance, real aluminum window frames. See actual stocked shelves, refrigerated drink cabinets and a checkout counter inside. Restrained warm shop lighting, realistic packaging silhouettes without brand names. Salt-worn concrete paving and a slim drain outside, weathered timber accents and a bench beside the shop. The clear entrance and walking route are unobstructed. Sea visible behind the shop. Physically plausible assembly details, realistic material scale, local weathering and soft reflected light. Cinematic but bright and believable, like a real photographed place, not cartoon, not miniature, not overly glossy. No people, no HUD, no weapons, no watermark.
